key_line.detail: No 2027 number and no quantification of the PH-ILD loss in the release. Qualitative: October patient shipments the highest monthly level since launch; October daily referral rate above 75% of the Q3 daily rate; referral-to-start conversion above 87%. Sandoz promotion agreement terminated, so service revenue ends.

guidance.detail: No financial guidance; the >$1bn 2027 ambition is neither restated nor withdrawn in the release (the call may have addressed it; not read).

call.detail: Webcast at 08:30 ET, so it is over before the open; its content (any 2027 or PH-ILD retention number) was not read in the time available.

public_reaction.summary: Not searched: no time before the 09:24 compile. Positioning context (not reaction): ~19% of shares short at 15 Oct, put skew +15.6 vol points.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 49.02 (+2.4%) against a frozen release read of +2.0%: about fair. Pre-market range 44.00-50.65 is wide; it traded up to 50.65 and has sagged back to 49.02. 60 prints but only 3 in the last 30 min, last at 09:08; not stale by rule. Well inside the 6.8% implied move. Market soft (IWM -0.9%, QQQ -1.0%). Short position -1.9% vs entry.

thesis_check.note: The short rested on a withdrawal or reset of the >$1bn 2027 ambition; the release gives no reset and the October demand lines are firm, so the negative line did not arrive (call unread). The headline GAAP loss is the known settlement charge.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is active enough (60 prints, not stale) so the open should hold most of +2.4%; the gap is small, it already sagged from 50.65, and small caps are weak this morning, so a modest fade toward yesterday's close by 10:00 is slightly more likely than not. The call is already done, so no event lands before 10:00.

recommendation.reason: De short staat voorbeurs ongeveer 2% in het verlies; het bericht bevat niet de verwachte verlaging van de 2027-ambitie en oktober was een recordmaand, dus de these is niet bevestigd. De koersstijging is klein en zakte al terug vanaf de top, en de markt is zwak, dus we verwachten in het eerste halfuur wat teruggave: dek de short om 10:00 af in plaats van om 13:00.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Stijgt de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 weer richting 50,65 of hoger (een short squeeze), dan direct bij de opening afdekken.
